description: Email/query with collapseThreads=true fetches COLLAPSE_THREADS_MAX_EMAILS (65536) email objects from the backend into process memory before slicing. A hostile client with a large account can trigger ~2 MiB of allocation per request with no per-connection or per-account rate guard. The comment documents the size but not the absence of any throttle.
title: collapseThreads loads up to 65536 objects into memory unconditionally
